svg.title: Cecil explains the circular complaint-number rule as Riju draws a loop.
svg.desc: Cecil points from the blank form to the portal and empty token slot, formally explaining that submission creates the number required to submit. Riju's pencil traces the procedure into a perfect empty circle.
